hints.title: Spiral Generation Obstacle
hints.text: Filling an n x n matrix with numbers 1 to n^2 along a clockwise spiral requires systematic coordinate progression. How can tracking outer boundary walls fill each tier sequentially in place?

hints.title: Strict Numerical Inward Fill Invariant
hints.text: Sequentially increment an accumulator from 1 to n^2 while filling top, right, bottom, and left boundary segments, shrinking boundaries upon layer completion.

hints.title: Concentric Ring Allocation Procedure
hints.text: Create an n x n grid. Set top = 0, bottom = n - 1, left = 0, right = n - 1, and num = 1. Fill row top from left to right, then increment top. Fill col right from top to bottom, then decrement right. Fill row bottom from right to left, then decrement bottom. Fill col left from bottom to top, then increment left. Continue until num > n^2.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def generateMatrix(self, n: int) -> List[List[int]]:
        matrix = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
        top, bottom = 0, n - 1
        left, right = 0, n - 1
        num = 1
        while top <= bottom and left <= right:
            for c in range(left, right + 1):
                matrix[top][c] = num
                num += 1
            top += 1
            for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
                matrix[r][right] = num
                num += 1
            right -= 1
            for c in range(right, left - 1, -1):
                matrix[bottom][c] = num
                num += 1
            bottom -= 1
            for r in range(bottom, top - 1, -1):
                matrix[r][left] = num
                num += 1
            left += 1
        return matrix
```

variables: N: dimension of square matrix (1 <= N <= 20)
complexity.notes: Every cell from 1 to N^2 is populated exactly once in O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direction vectors without wall bounds require collision checks on every step.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct writing into the output grid consumes zero auxiliary storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct handling of odd n where the final center element is populated.
